content:
The **lightweight mini nuke** is a *Fallout 76* grenade that is unused.

While visually identical to the Nuka Grenade, this item was half the weight and generated only by the cut legendary perk card Nuclear Proliferator.

On the Public Test Server (PTS), the grenade was initially named "Fission grenade," but was bugged and caused no damage. In a later PTS update, the grenade was fixed. A final PTS update renamed the grenade to "Lightweight mini nuke," but the grenade itself and the Nuclear Proliferator legendary perk were both cut. Neither was ever used in a live version of Fallout 76.
